draft.subject: One quick step to get Cedar Works moving
draft.body:
Hi Tunde,

Following up on our welcome call last week -- I know the shift from docs and chat threads takes a beat, so I don't want setup to stall out on you.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so one real project is usually the whole unlock. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm glad to walk through your first project with you live.

Best,
Priya
